title: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design
title_zh: AutoDesign：面向长程智能体设计的 Meta-Harness 优化
abstract_en: Transforming multimodal sources into condensed and structured media outputs can be fundamentally conceptualized as a long-horizon agentic process centered on a model-harness system. While an ideal harness system should align with human design priors and accumulate reusable experience through empirical exploration to drive recursive self-improvement, existing paradigms remain static and fall short of this capability. In this paper, we present AutoDesign, a framework that aligns with human design priors, where a meta-harness optimizer guides a code agent to recursively improve harness based on rollout feedback. To instantiate and evaluate this framework, we focus on the academic paper-to-poster generation task and introduce PosterBench, comprising a 100-paper Main Track spanning five disciplines and PosterBench-mini, a shared 10-paper subset for controlled evaluation. On the PosterBench Main Track, AutoDesign achieves the highest score of 78.32, surpassing the closed-source commercial system Claude Design by 7.45 points. Across seven controlled code-agent-model configurations, integrating the learned DesignHarness consistently improves performance, increasing the average PosterBench Score from 54.99 to 67.39 (+12.4%). In a fully autonomous long-horizon loop, it executes 253 tool calls and 11 editing turns within 40 minutes for under $3, reaching average conference-poster quality in human evaluation. A system-blind human study further demonstrates that AutoDesign achieves the highest human preference among evaluated systems.
abstract_zh: 本文将多模态来源转化为精炼、结构化媒体输出的过程，视为围绕 model-harness system 展开的长程智能体流程。理想的 harness system 应能对齐人类设计先验，并通过经验探索积累可复用经验，从而实现递归式自我改进；但现有范式多为静态系统，难以具备这种能力。为此，论文提出 AutoDesign：一个符合人类设计先验的框架，其中 meta-harness optimizer 根据 rollout feedback 指导 code agent 递归改进 harness。作者以学术论文到海报生成任务为实例，构建 PosterBench 基准，包括覆盖五个学科的 100 篇论文 Main Track，以及用于受控评测的 10 篇共享子集 PosterBench-mini。在 PosterBench Main Track 上，AutoDesign 得分 78.32，超过闭源商业系统 Claude Design 7.45 分。在七种受控 code-agent-model 配置中，集成学习得到的 DesignHarness 均稳定提升性能，使平均 PosterBench Score 从 54.99 提升至 67.39（+12.4%）。在完全自主的长程循环中，系统可在 40 分钟内、成本低于 3 美元的条件下执行 253 次工具调用和 11 轮编辑，并在人类评估中达到平均会议海报质量。系统盲测的人类偏好研究进一步表明，AutoDesign 在被评估系统中获得最高偏好。
key_points_zh: 提出 AutoDesign，将长程设计任务建模为 model-harness system 的递归优化过程，由 meta-harness optimizer 基于 rollout feedback 指导 code agent 改进 DesignHarness。
构建 PosterBench 基准用于论文到海报生成评测，包含覆盖五个学科的 100-paper Main Track，以及用于受控实验的 10-paper PosterBench-mini。
AutoDesign 在 PosterBench Main Track 上取得 78.32 分，较闭源商业系统 Claude Design 高 7.45 分，并在人类偏好盲测中排名最高。
在七种受控 code-agent-model 配置中，加入学习得到的 DesignHarness 均带来稳定增益，平均分从 54.99 提升到 67.39，提升 12.4%。
系统展示了低成本长程自主设计能力：40 分钟内完成 253 次工具调用和 11 轮编辑，成本低于 3 美元，并达到平均会议海报质量。

llm_assessment.comment: The paper fits well as meta-harness optimization with rollout feedback and recursive improvement, despite being evaluated on a design task.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 论文通过反馈驱动的元框架优化和递归改进契合本领域，尽管评测任务是设计生成。
